mesh.description: Inline triangle geometry. Indices must be a non-empty multiple of 3, every index must be inside the vertex list, and total triangle area must be > 0 (degenerate meshes fail). The collision-grid size guard (4,000,000 cells) is validator-only.

vertices.description: Triangle soup vertices, each a [x, y, z] array of finite numbers.

vec3.description: A 3-component vector [x, y, z]. Must be exactly 3 finite numbers; null fails in settings (a settings vector must be an array), and counts as absent on an emitter field.

description: JSON Schema for the versioned particle system definition that particles lane 5 (ParticleAuthoring.cs, ParticleSystemDef) reads and writes: a version stamp, an optional name, settings, and emitters, with inline mesh geometry for MeshSurface emitters and settings collision meshes. Units are kernel inches, Z-up, seconds, vectors as [x, y, z] arrays. A seed is always serialized (Geppetto's sim is deterministic per seed). This schema states the CANONICAL document shape: canonical spellings, the one required field, and the numeric ranges of ParticleSystemSettings.Validate() / ParticleEmitter.Validate(). Parser tolerances that JSON Schema cannot express live in the companion validator (ParticleSchema.cs), which is authoritative for them: unknown fields are IGNORED at every level (forward compat, never rejected); field names match case-insensitively, last-wins; enum spellings are case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant and numeric strings parse as their enum value (a renderType numeric string that parses but names no member is still accepted by lane 5, which only special-cases Strand); preset names resolve loosely (fx:/vfx:/particle: prefixes, dashes/spaces/slashes as underscores, a preset carried as a whole underscore-separated word). Cross-field rules (lifetimeMin <= lifetimeMax, sizeMin <= sizeMax, groundNormal non-zero only when groundEnabled, vortexAxis non-zero only when vortexStrength is non-zero, direction non-zero except Area/MeshSurface with UseSurfaceNormal, mesh total area > 0) are validator-only and noted on the fields they guard. P50 (definition migration) consumes this file.

emitters.description: Emitters in this system. Optional: when omitted the system has no emitters (valid, emitterless). An explicit null fails in lane 5.

angularSpeedMax.description: Max angular speed, radians/s, about a random axis.

areaU.description: Area shape: half-extent edge vector U of the parallelogram. Area edges must be finite and non-parallel (validator-only rule).

areaV.description: Area shape: half-extent edge vector V of the parallelogram.

baseVelocity.description: Added to every launch velocity (for example emitter motion).

boxHalfExtents.description: Box shape: axis-aligned half extents, each >= 0.

bursts.description: Step bursts. A present list replaces a preset's bursts wholesale, even when empty. Each entry defaults step/count to 0 when omitted.

step.description: Fixed step at which the burst fires.

direction.description: Launch direction. For Area/MeshSurface with useSurfaceNormal the surface normal is used instead. Zero direction + speed > 0 fails, except for Area/MeshSurface with useSurfaceNormal; a preset emitter's zero direction override is ignored (the preset direction stands) (validator-only rules).

lifetimeMin.description: Minimum particle lifetime, seconds. Must satisfy 0 < lifetimeMin <= lifetimeMax against the merged (preset + override) values (validator-only cross-field rule).

mesh.description: Inline triangle geometry. Required when shape is MeshSurface; when present on any shape it is validated (a degenerate mesh fails even on a Point emitter). Null counts as absent.

name.description: Optional emitter label. Ignored by the simulation (a preset name is a construction shortcut, not state, and does not survive FromSystem).

position.description: Point position / area, box, sphere centre. For a preset emitter this is the preset's origin.

preset.description: Preset to start from (ParticleEmitterPresets); fields actually present in this emitter override it, and a present bursts list replaces the preset's bursts wholesale. Canonical names: water_splash, bubbles, blood_mist, sparks, dust_motes, breath_frost, fire, smoke, rain, snow, leaves, confetti, steam, magic_sparkle. The validator resolves names loosely per lane 5 (prefixes, separators, whole-word carrying); this schema deliberately does not enum-constrain the field so those spellings stay describable.

rate.description: Particles per second (continuous, fractional remainder carried between steps).

shape.description: Emitter shape. Canonical names only here; the validator additionally accepts lane 5's ParseEnum spellings, and rejects integer strings that name no member (for example "5").

sizeMin.description: Minimum particle size. Must satisfy 0 < sizeMin <= sizeMax against the merged values (validator-only cross-field rule).

speed.description: Launch speed; actual speed is uniformly in speed * (1 +/- speedJitter).

spreadDegrees.description: Cone half-angle around the launch direction, degrees (180 = any direction).

useSurfaceNormal.description: For Area/MeshSurface, launch along the surface normal instead of direction.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the definition. Carried through round-trips; ignored by the simulation.

settings.description: System-wide simulation settings. Optional: when omitted, every field takes the live ParticleSystemSettings default. An explicit null fails in lane 5.

collisionMesh.description: Optional inline collision mesh. Null is accepted (no mesh); when present it is validated like an emitter mesh.

fixedDeltaTime.description: Fixed step in seconds (60 Hz by default).

friction.description: Tangential velocity retained on contact is (1 - friction).

gravity.description: Gravity acceleration, inches/s^2. Default is 9.80665 m/s^2 in inches/s^2, pointing -Z.

groundEnabled.description: Whether the ground plane is active. A zero groundNormal is only an error when this is true (validator-only rule).

groundOffset.description: Ground plane offset; the free half space is Normal.x >= Offset + CollisionRadius.

renderType.description: How a renderer should draw the particles; the simulation is identical for all three. Canonical names only here; the validator additionally accepts lane 5's ParseEnum spellings (case/whitespace variants and integer strings).

seed.description: Deterministic seed, always serialized. 0 is valid (the RNG remaps it); the full uint32 range is accepted.

strandPoints.description: Strand history points kept per particle (0 = off). Strand render type needs at least 2 (see the if/then below).

turbulenceSpeed.description: How fast the noise field scrolls, noise units/s. Any finite value.

turbulenceStrength.description: Curl-noise acceleration magnitude scale, inches/s^2. 0 disables.

vortexAxis.description: Vortex rotation axis. Must be non-zero when vortexStrength is non-zero (validator-only rule).

vortexRadius.description: Vortex core radius in the acceleration denominator.

vortexStrength.description: Vortex acceleration scale. 0 disables; a non-zero strength requires a non-zero vortexAxis (validator-only rule).

wind.description: Air velocity; only acts through drag.

version.description: Schema version. Lane 5 reads version 1 only; a missing, non-integer, or non-1 version fails. Matched case-sensitively for presence by lane 5's pre-check, case-insensitively and last-wins by its deserializer.

title: Geppetto particle system definition, schema v1
